details: This package runs a host-metadata beacon at install time. Its postinstall hook executes index.js, which collects the package name, the current OS username (os.userInfo().username) and the machine hostname (os.hostname()), serialises them as JSON and POSTs them over HTTPS to hxxps://nathanaccacio[.]com/collect. The request is fire-and-forget: errors are swallowed and installation continues normally, so the collection is not visible to the installer. The package contains no other functionality — no API client, no linter — and reads no environment variables, credential files or tokens; the data sent is limited to username, hostname and package name.
